questions.answer:
Model:
Apply the model for Two-Level Systems and the Schottky Anomaly under every condition stated in the question; use SI units unless another unit is explicitly supplied.

At low temperature, equation \([1]\) gives \(p_1\simeq e^{-\Delta/(k_{\mathrm B}T)}\), so the upper level is frozen out and energy barely changes.
